sources.content: The quessit-agent image runs Quessit, an agent that tails container log files and ships them to a central store. It is built on ubuntu:24.04 and, unlike most images, runs as root, because it must read log files owned by other users. Mount the host directory /var/log/containers read only at the same path inside the container. Quessit keeps its read positions in /var/lib/quessit/offsets.db. The entrypoint is /opt/quessit/bin/quessit. The image is published for amd64 and arm64 hosts.

Configuration. QUESSIT_ENDPOINT sets the destination URL and must be set; there is no default. QUESSIT_BATCH_SIZE sets lines per request and defaults to 500. QUESSIT_FLUSH_SECONDS defaults to 5. When the endpoint is down, Quessit buffers up to 256 MB on disk and then drops the oldest lines. The agent exposes its own metrics on port 2020. The health check calls /health on that port every 15 seconds. QUESSIT_TLS_VERIFY defaults to true; set it to false only for testing.
